brief: The tomato: one completed focus interval at the desk. Sits in the HUD beside the count and on every journal entry that earned some.
sketchNote: A round tomato with a small stem and leaves on top, highlight top-left, shadow bottom-right.
use: the pet, the tray and menu bar, the app icon, a tomato beside every count, the pomodoro mode in the Plus menu, the Desk tab on the phone
